features.title: Everything your team needs, in one workspace
features.description: Stop stitching together five tools. Presk keeps your work, conversations and files connected by default.
features.aiWorkflowsDescription: Automate standups, summaries and task updates so your team stays focused on the work that matters.
features.onePlaceDescription: Projects, messaging, calendars and files share the same people, context and permissions.

features.schedulingDescription: See team availability, schedule meetings and sync events across every calendar view.
features.filePermissionsDescription: Share documents with view, comment or edit access — down to the individual file.
features.conversationsDescription: Threads, reactions and mentions keep discussions attached to the work they're about.

testimonials.title: Loved by teams who ship
testimonials.description: From startups to enterprises, teams use Presk to stay aligned and move faster.
testimonials.q1: Presk replaced four tools for us. Projects, chat and files finally live in the same place, so context never gets lost.
testimonials.q2: The AI assistants handle the busywork — standups, summaries, task updates. My team got a full day back every week.
testimonials.q3: Permissions and organizations were ready out of the box. We rolled it out to 200 people in an afternoon.
testimonials.q4: It feels like a single product instead of a bundle. The calendar and files are as good as the project boards.
